title: Add collection channel and collection point in "get liability details"

storage.value:
Abbreviations

UIC

Unique Identification Code of a customer, equal to Customer Identifier in Phoenix

Business Need & Purpose

As a customer of Energo-Pro Sales or Energo-Pro Energy services,

I want to see details about a liability,

So that I can easily get an overview of it and potentially pay it

 

Business Flow Fit (Trigger & Outcome)

The story is relevant for the Customer Portal. Customer logs in and navigates to the “Invoices and Payments” section, where the list of liabilities is displayed. At this step the portal will receive the IDs of all liabilities in the list. When the user clicks on a liability, the Portal sends the GET request with the ID provided in the first step and upon receiving the response, displays more detailed information and an option to pay it.

 

Request Parameters

Request Type: GET

Endpoint: /liability/{id}

Bilingual logic:

  • The language parameter could have two values: Bulgarian and English

  • If the request is sent with the Bulgarian language parameter, we should return the default values ââin the response.

  • If the request is sent with the English language parameter, we should return the "transliterated" values ââin the response

  • The language parameter is optional in request

  • If the language parameter is not specified in the request, we should return the default values.

  • If the language parameter is specified in the request, but we don’t have transliterated value for that nomenclatures, we should return the default value

  • If the language parameter is specified in the request, we have transliterated field for that nomenclature but it’s empty, we should return the default value

 

Response Parameters

When the liability is retrieved, Phoenix should return a JSON with the following attributes of all selected liabilities.
